changelog:
Endurance
 Voice Stats: complete Voice Config diagnostics per page—overview, wake word, library, microphone, noise suppression, echo cancellation, voiceprint, audio events, streaming TTS, feedback accent. Pull bottom handle, live status, no sensitive data. Thanks @lone-baggie #157.

Five-band EQ: independent per music source, 80Hz–10kHz, ±10dB. No root required. Path: Settings → Interaction → Media & Playback.

Expanded lyrics: tap cover for lyrics wall, swipe scroll, tap line to adjust timing, double-tap to seek with Music Assistant. Mini overlay stays out when paused.

WebView Health Steward (Beta): reduces idle work, prioritizes visible page, rest state when hidden, preserves login/content. Path: Settings → Browser → Page Display.

Web screensaver: rest when hidden, restore content, catch up HA states, recover from failures. Pixel Shift moves content not window. Thanks @pantherale0 #132, @deergitseason #160.

Kiosk sidebar toggle, Dual Pages intelligent empty space, shared Web Console.

Smart AEC: Light/Standard/Strong + Near/Living/Open room. Pause while speaking option. Software/hardware never stacked. Path: Settings → Voice Config → Microphone.

Smart NS: Light/Standard/Strong, software/hardware never stacked. Path: Settings → Voice Config → Microphone.

Simple Clock dark-room screen-off, independent from web screensaver. Pixel Shift fixed.

Bluetooth IRK auto-obtain, proxy restart fixes, quiet-period stability. Long-run fixes: camera cleanup, voice restart state, Mod clean return, music fade, Quick Entity background stop.
